data.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: No reviewer agent definition file contains references to REVIEW_RESULT, MIN_SCORE, or a scores object in its output contract
- DD2: reviewer-base.md specifies exactly two top-level keys (findings, summary) in the JSON schema and a 3-line output format (REVIEWER_HASH, FINDING_COUNT, FILES)
- DD3: Each reviewer agent definition includes a mandatory pre-output checklist requiring consideration of all 5 categories before writing findings

## File to modify
plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-base.md (296 lines)

## Changes required

### 1. Update Mandatory Output Contract (lines ~14-25)
Change from 5-line output:
  REVIEW_RESULT: {passed|failed}
  REVIEWER_HASH={sha256}
  MIN_SCORE={lowest numeric score}
  FINDING_COUNT={N}
  FILES: {list}

To 3-line output:
  REVIEWER_HASH={sha256 of reviewer-findings.json}
  FINDING_COUNT={N}
  FILES: {comma-separated list of files referenced in findings}

### 2. Remove pass/fail rule based on scores (lines ~23-25)
Remove: '**Pass/fail rule**: REVIEW_RESULT is passed only when every numeric score is 4 or 5...'
Replace with: a note that pass/fail is determined by record-review.sh from findings severity (not by the agent)

### 3. Update JSON Schema (lines ~99-140)
Change:
  REQUIRED: EXACTLY three top-level keys: 'scores', 'findings', 'summary'
  The 'scores' object MUST contain ALL five dimensions...

To:
  REQUIRED: EXACTLY two top-level keys: 'findings' and 'summary'
  Do NOT include a 'scores' object — it has been removed from the schema.

Remove the scores example (lines with hygiene, design, maintainability, correctness, verification integer values).
Keep the findings array structure (severity, category, file, description).
Keep the summary field.

### 4. Add Pre-output Category Checklist
Add a new section before the write-reviewer-findings.sh call (around line 270+):

## Pre-Output Category Coverage Check
Before writing your findings JSON, verify you have considered all 5 review categories:
- [ ] correctness — logic errors, off-by-one, null-pointer, wrong algorithm
- [ ] verification — test coverage, test quality, edge case coverage
- [ ] hygiene — naming, formatting, dead code, unnecessary complexity
- [ ] design — coupling, cohesion, interface clarity, SOLID principles
- [ ] maintainability — documentation, readability, future-change cost

If you have found NO issues in a category, that is fine — record your check with a note that the category was reviewed and found clean. Do not invent findings to fill categories.

### 5. Update error output format
Remove any references to 'REVIEW_RESULT: error' — replace with just stopping and returning REVIEWER_HASH (or nothing on fatal error).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] reviewer-base.md does NOT contain REVIEW_RESULT in output contract section
  Verify: ! grep -q 'REVIEW_RESULT' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-base.md
- [ ] reviewer-base.md does NOT contain MIN_SCORE in output contract section
  Verify: ! grep -q 'MIN_SCORE' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-base.md
- [ ] reviewer-base.md does NOT contain scores object in schema section
  Verify: ! grep -q '"scores"' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-base.md
- [ ] reviewer-base.md contains 2-key schema specification
  Verify: grep -q 'EXACTLY two top-level keys' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-base.md
- [ ] reviewer-base.md contains pre-output category checklist
  Verify: grep -q 'Pre-Output Category' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-base.md
- [ ] reviewer-base.md specifies 3-line output (REVIEWER_HASH, FINDING_COUNT, FILES only)
  Verify: grep -q 'REVIEWER_HASH' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-base.md && ! grep -q 'REVIEW_RESULT' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/docs/workflows/prompts/reviewer-base.md
- [ ] tests/docs/test-reviewer-base-file-constraint.sh passes (8/8 after T1+T3)
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/docs/test-reviewer-base-file-constraint.sh 2>&1 | grep -q 'PASSED'

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: GREEN: Update reviewer-base.md — 2-key schema, 3-line output, pre-output checklist
